LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNACosmeticApplication.label: PNA cosmetic application
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNACosmeticApplication.descripti: Discover the tissue-reshaping properties of regular PNA and control them through measured application and surgery. Unlocks cosmetic reshaping surgery: each success raises vanilla Beauty by one step, up to Beautiful (+2). Higher modded Beauty and conflicting traits remain untouched.
